name: Mikami Miina
source:
A young wife who met and married Jun while attending a junior college. They have been married for two years.
She is ladylike, kind, and gentle, and always tries to support her husband Jun, who is, in a sense, an overachieving spouse.
She is a bit on the presumptuous side and sometimes surprises people with her mysterious behavior.

She has never been interested in such things, so she does not have much sexual knowledge.
She has only had one experience with Jun, her current husband.
